item.description:
Added

  • Lunar disk autoguiding through a ZWO camera's ST-4 port: detect the Moon, calibrate, set a target and guide.
  • Monochrome and color ZWO cameras. A color camera's raw Bayer image is turned into a gray image, so the Moon shows no color checkerboard.
  • Daytime and twilight Moon detection.
  • Camera controls with Moon-based Auto exposure and gain.
  • Lunar limb focus indicator.
  • Simulation and replay modes for trying MoonGuide without hardware.
  • In-app updates (MoonGuide ▸ Check for Updates…). Updates never interrupt calibration or guiding.
